title: FormationEval, an open multiple-choice benchmark for petroleum geoscience

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the tendency of language models to select the longest answer choice and measuring the baseline frequency within the dataset of correct answers being the uniquely longest option.
Measuring the deviation of models' selected answers from a uniform A/B/C/D distribution to identify if models disproportionately favor specific answer letters.

Analyzing the dataset for exploitable linguistic patterns, specifically the presence of absolute words (e.g., 'always') exclusively in distractors and hedged words (e.g., 'may') exclusively in correct answers.
